verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents a sandbox with dedicated /simulations/cardtransactions/* endpoints, one per event type, for simulating card network transactions such as authorizations and reversals. A quick-start tutorial walks through simulating a transaction, and the sandbox is isolated from real card networks. Gateway JIT funding lets your own system approve or deny requests, which ties the simulations to custom auth logic. missing for 10: explicit evidence of clearing/settlement, refund, and decline simulation endpoints, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the full lifecycle simulation.
